treatment_a.failure: QueryRejected: Only agentic_analytics.delivery_work_items may be queried.
treatment_a.observed_sql: SELECT team, 100 * SUM(blocked) / COUNT(*) AS blocked_pct FROM delivery_work_items GROUP BY team ORDER BY blocked_pct DESC LIMIT 1

observed_sequence: Parent made one valid single-task delegation.
Child used an unqualified table name; the unchanged validator rejected the query.
Child successfully retrieved the KPI policy definition.
The two-call evidence budget was exhausted; five later child evidence attempts were blocked.
Child returned an incomplete SystemBenchmarkResponse after six model calls.
delegate_task was absent from all six subsequent parent requests.
Parent attempted six forbidden evidence calls; all were blocked; no second worker launched.
Parent returned the child's incomplete response and the treatment was not score-eligible.

harness_analysis_note.finding: The inherited M0.5B retirement evaluator required exactly two parent requests and therefore labeled retirement false when the real benchmark produced seven parent requests. The preregistered M0.6 criterion required delegate_task to be absent from the subsequent parent request, not exactly one follow-up request.
harness_analysis_note.raw_evidence: The first parent request exposed delegate_task; every one of the six later parent requests exposed only query_clickhouse and retrieve_policy.
harness_analysis_note.corrected_interpretation: Post-success delegate_task retirement held. No model message, tool array, tool result, benchmark output, or score artifact was edited; repository request copies redact only Authorization headers with original and sanitized hashes in redaction-manifest.json. The benchmark was not rerun, and this correction does not change the failing treatment or M1 verdict.
harness_analysis_note.second_finding: The original orchestration summary counted five child budget-blocked evidence attempts as parent work because those event rows omit delegated_child. Event order around delegate_post proves six, not eleven, parent evidence attempts.

comparison.reason_primary_metric_undefined: Neither treatment produced an accepted result.
comparison.shared_failure: Both direct execution and the delegated child generated the same unqualified delivery_work_items table reference on their first SQL attempt.
comparison.hermes_specific_behavior: Hermes preserved the one-delegation/one-child limit and post-success delegation retirement, but the child exhausted the evidence budget after the rejected query and the parent repeatedly attempted forbidden evidence work.

m1_readiness.verdict: M0.6 does not support transition to M1
m1_readiness.reason: Hermes did not produce a score-eligible accepted result and required repeated enforcement of child budget and parent evidence boundaries, despite correct single-child delegation retirement.

next_experiment.name: M0.7 blocker-rate SQL qualification micro-study
next_experiment.smallest_observed_blocker: The frozen Qwen path omitted the required fully qualified ClickHouse table name for the realistic blocker-rate aggregate in both treatments.
next_experiment.single_intervention: Change only the query_clickhouse model-visible contract wording to state explicitly that SQL must reference the exact fully qualified table agentic_analytics.delivery_work_items. Keep the validator, dataset, model, context, temperature, SQL normalization policy, and evidence semantics unchanged.
next_experiment.design: Preregister three distinct realistic blocker-rate aggregate prompts; one scheduled attempt per prompt; query_clickhouse only; zero retry, repair, or normalization; require 3/3 first calls to pass the unchanged validator and return exact expected rows.
next_experiment.why_no_control_rerun: The current frozen contract already produced the same qualification failure in two independent M0.6 paths; rerunning it would spend local compute without adding a new engineering fact.
next_experiment.decision_rule: If 3/3 pass, define a fresh successor A/B without reusing or overwriting M0.6. If any case fails, preserve it and test bounded validator-feedback recovery as a separate intervention.
